PC:
Get information about the following components of her medical history

History of Present Illness

Past Medical History

Medications

Allergies

Family History

Social History

Health Related Behaviors
Elicit the patient’s understanding of her medical illness and how her illness has affected her function on a daily basis.
Inquire about psychosocial stressors and their impact on her ability to manage her illness.
Inquire about the impact of the patient’s illness on her family and their role in helping to manage her illness.
ICS: Open the interview (greet the patient, make introductions, inquire into patient’s purpose for the visit)
Build a relationship and establish rapport
Engage in open-ended inquiry, listening, summarizing
PBLI:
Student interviewer should first give his/her perceptions of the interview, including:

what went well and what to focus on improving.
